title: Valid Palindrome
description:
A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward.

Write a function `isPalindrome(s)` that returns `true` if `s` is a palindrome, or `false` otherwise.

examples.input: isPalindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")

tests.name: Sample Test 1: Standard palindrome with punctuation
input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
